🟡 **Historical Goals include future merges** With a historical `--now`, `recent` includes PRs merged after that time because it checks only the lower bound. Goals labels those future merges as occurring in the last 24 hours.
Learn more The dashboard accepts `--now` as a build timestamp. The existing [inDay](https://github.com/rayfernando1337/kongroyale/blob/806649ffc2d9203e2e4649c0dd25997a2e3dddaa/tools/dashboard/build.mts#L109 "tools/dashboard/build.mts:109") filter includes both bounds, but `recent` only checks whether a merged PR is no more than 24 hours old; a future merge produces a negative difference and passes. This makes historical Goals output inconsistent with Overview. **Example:** Build at November 5, 12:00 UTC with a PR merged November 6, 12:00 UTC. Goals shows that PR under “merged in the last 24 hours,” while Overview excludes it. **Recommended fix:** In `renderGoalsPage`, require `Date.parse(p.mergedAt) <= ctx.now` as well as the existing 24-hour lower bound.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🟡 **Dual-channel release loses next status** When `nextTag` equals `stableTag`, `channel` displays only stable. The release no longer shows that the same build also occupies next.
Learn more Release channels are separate movable tags. The earlier [release cards](https://github.com/rayfernando1337/kongroyale/blob/806649ffc2d9203e2e4649c0dd25997a2e3dddaa/tools/dashboard/build.mts "tools/dashboard/build.mts") rendered both pills when both tags pointed to the same release. The new channel ternary and the rail ternary each choose stable before checking next, so the next assignment disappears. **Example:** Set both `stable` and `next` to `kong-v1.1.0`. The release card and rail say only “stable,” although both channel tags point to this release. **Recommended fix:** Render both channel labels when both tags match, including in the rail, rather than selecting one with a ternary.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🟡 **Release schedule vanishes between releases** When `unreleased` is empty, `unreleasedList` removes the only release schedule text. Visitors cannot see the schedule just after main has been fully released.
Learn more The Releases page previously rendered [releaseTrain](https://github.com/rayfernando1337/kongroyale/blob/806649ffc2d9203e2e4649c0dd25997a2e3dddaa/tools/dashboard/data.json "tools/dashboard/data.json") regardless of pending changes. The replacement puts that text inside the conditional pending-changes block. A fully released main branch therefore loses the schedule, even though the Releases page is still available. **Example:** Cut a release containing every merged PR, leaving `unreleased.length === 0`. The Releases page lists the tags but no longer shows when releases are planned. **Recommended fix:** Render the release schedule independently of `unreleased.length`; condition only the pending PR list on that count.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Upstream finish line and progress differ** The upstream goal defines 100% as every PR reviewed, but `upMerged / upTotal` measures acceptance. A reviewed, closed PR never advances the bar. Clarify which outcome the goal tracks. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Overflow link omits open PRs** The Goals overflow link points to Overview, which lists last-day merged highlights, not open PRs. Open entries beyond the eight-row limit remain on Waiting instead. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Empty state overstates release coverage** When `nextTag` exists, `unreleased` checks only commits after that tag. An older merged PR omitted from release notes can leave the list empty despite never appearing in a release. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*
